plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Music - Vocal Performance Emphasis program page (poid=10885) and its linked official degree map, 'Music & Music Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Vocal Perf (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (13/16/16/14/15/16/15/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BM Degree: 120. SUU is an accredited institutional member of the National Association of Schools of Music (NASM). Per the catalog, students must be admitted to SUU as a Music major; complete MUSC 1110, 1120, 1130, 1140, 2110, 2130, 2140 and 3070 with a grade of 'C-' or better and MUSC 2410 with a grade of 'B-' or better; earn a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.75 (and 2.75 in all Music courses required for the BM); complete a Piano Proficiency Exam (the map marks MUSC 2110/2130 with its piano-proficiency footnote); and the Performance Emphasis is open by audition only. The catalog's Music Core Requirements (43 credits) are exercised exactly by the map: every named core course is placed, with MUSC 1410, 2410, 3410 and 4410 Individual Applied Music Instruction each appearing twice at 2 credits (the catalog's 'must complete 4 credits' each) and MUSC 3800 Junior Recital and MUSC 4800 Senior Recital as 0-credit requirements (required_zero); allow_repeated_courses is set for these printed repeats and for MUSC 0990. The catalog's Vocal Performance Emphasis Requirements (41 credits) are exercised exactly: MUSC 1170, 1620, 2680, 3370, 2670, 4610 and 4620 as placed, the Major Ensemble Requirement as the map's eight 1-credit choice rows carrying the catalog's six ensemble options (8 credits in all), and the Foreign Language Requirement (16 credits) as the map's LANG 1010, 1020, 2010 and 2020 rows at 4 credits each, which carry the catalog's two groups (French: FREN 1010, 1020, 2010, 2020; German: GER 1010, 1020, 2010, 2020); the map notes students must take either French or German. DISCLOSED, transcribed as printed and not reconciled: (1) the catalog requires MUSC 0990 Recital Attendance for 7 semesters; the map prints a 0-credit MUSC 0990 row in all eight terms, recorded as printed (no credit total is affected). (2) Catalog course titles are recorded where the map differs: MUSC 2680 is catalogued as 'French Diction & Repertoire' (map: 'French Diction & Literature for Singers'), MUSC 2670 as 'German Diction & Repertoire' (map: 'German Diction & Literature for Singers'), and MUSC 3370 as 'Opera Workshop' (catalogued 0-2 credits, must complete 2 credits; the map places it once at 2 credits labelled 'Opera/Musical Theatre'). GE and ensemble rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
